description: Source code for 'makeamitbin', a utility to create firmware binaries for MGB100 devices, including functions for reading files, creating headers, checksum calculation, and command-line processing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, file reading, header creation, and output file writing.

methods.name: show_fwids
methods.description: Displays a list of known firmware identifiers.

methods.name: find_hdrinfo
methods.description: Finds header information struct by name.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads a file into memory and returns data pointer and size.

methods.name: makehdr
methods.description: Creates a header for firmware segment based on info and data.

methods.name: showhdr
methods.description: Displays header content in hex and ASCII.
